slides.title: Esercizio 3 – Diagnosi ITALIAN VERSION
ENGLISH VERSION
slides.body:
Analyzing the database, extract the following information:
List of all RDIs (Diagnostic Trouble Codes)List of all I/O componentsList of all routinesConsidering the well-known diagnostic service associated withIOLIs (Input/Output Line Interface), choose one from the listextracted in point 1:
Verify the active sub-services according to the informationprovided by the Control Data Dictionary (CDD)Using the correct syntax, activate all the functions provided forthat IOLI, in coherence with the CDDOnce the IOLI is activated, subsequently verify itscorrespondence by utilizing the corresponding RDI, if available:Is the value sent by the IOLI consistent with what is reported bythe RDI?Considering one of the routines extracted from point 1:
Check the CDD for any enabled sub-routinesStrictly following all enabling conditions and using the correctsyntax, command the initiation of the routine and verify theresponse obtained from the diagnostic tool; then request anyavailable report and verify the response from the toolStrictly following all enabling conditions, command the possiblestop of the routine, according to the CDD description, and verifythe response from the tool; then request any available report

slides.title: and verify the response from the tool.
